Ever wonder what a day of an FBA Amazon Seller looks like? 
In this video, I'll take you with me so you can witness what my day looks like and to show you as well how selling in Amazon changed my life. 

I didn't always sell at Amazon. I started my E-Commerce website www.bdancewear.com 5 years ago when I quit my job. At first, we just sold on our own website but was eventually persuaded to sell on Amazon because of a few friends who convinced me on how much easier my life would be if I sell on Amazon and they were right. 

As of now, I only work once a week for my Amazon Product, Performance Nut Butter. I only do this every Tuesday so I try get a lot of things done as much as possible. The day I filmed this video, I woke up at 3:00 AM but since I work for myself now, I was able to go back to sleep despite having a lot of anxiety about the things that I need to do. 
I started my regular morning routine then spent majority of my morning working on my computer, had lunch with friends and spontaneously went to the beach and played spike ball. This is something that I don't normally do when I work for Performance Nut Butter but again, this is one of the many benefits of being an Amazon FBA seller. You can always decide if you want to stop working and just go back to work when you're ready. The rest of the night I spent with my girlfriend Ariana as we had dinner, happy hour and do some Salsa.
The BIG LESSON I've learned in the last five years of being an Entrepenuer?
It's all about the relationships you have. It's easy to think that you can do this on your own or conquer the world on your own. But you would only end up locking yourself in your room and just draining yourself. Having the ability to have lunch with my friends and go to the beach diminished all the anxiety I was feeling that morning. Always remind yourself that while you spend time grinding and working hard towards your goal, just make sure you are still developing and enjoying the relationships around you.
